image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The image clearly shows the characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates (valves) surrounded by a hairy, spiny girdle. The plates exhibit radial growth lines and mottled brown/grey coloration. The subject is centered, filling most of the frame.
